description: Erection of a first floor side extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [HO-02_PL/01 (rev 1) - Received on 14/11/2023; HO-09_PL/02, HO-09_PL/03, HO-09_PL/04, Fire safety strategy-   Received on 09/10/2023].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the enjoyment of the house at the '96 Bedfont Close Feltham TW14 8LF' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling other than as described in the submitted application, nor used for business purposes and shall not have a separate external entrance.
